title: Anne NDE 7805
content: I'm writing this in my mother's name, because her English isn't very good. The incident happened in the year 2005. My mother was 62 years old at that time and I was 26. I'm her daughter. We were sitting in the living room. My mother stood up and walked to the closet to get something off the highest shelf. She got on top of an unstable stool to stand on. While reaching for the top shelf, she lost her balance, fell from the stool and banged her head on the hard floor. My uncle and I immediately rushed to help my mom. She was lying on the floor with her eyes closed. After maybe half a minute she opened her eyes. She had a very confused look and her eyes were glazed over. She wasn't herself, but was just a moving body, not really present inside her body. We helped her to walk to the sofa and I was sitting next to her on the chair the whole time until she was back to her normal self. The next day, she told me that when she fell off the stool she suddenly found herself in an unknown and different place. She was sitting in a vehicle that was driving or moving forward on a road. Next to her, on her left hand side, she knew someone was sitting and 'driving' her. But for some reason, she couldn't move her head to the left; she could only look to her right and to the front. The vehicle had no roof. She was sitting in a chair. I asked my mom if the vehicle looked like a car, but my mother wasn't sure, it was just something that looked like a car, but was floating or gliding over the road. Next to the road there was a pavement with people walking in slow peace. A bit further she saw green grass, trees and in the distance beautiful detached houses. The road the vehicle was moving on had high trees on both sides. The people who walked on the pavement looked all very happy. Some of them waved to my mom and smiled. She saw her deceased husband who was my stepfather. He bent forward towards the car, smiled and waved to her. He was there with Blondie, our golden retriever dog who died a long time ago. My mom also saw her old fiancé from when she was young who died in a car crash. She also saw a few other people who aren't alive any longer. There was also a woman who was an old friend of my mother, but they lost contact years ago. My mom was surprised to see her there because she thought the woman was still alive. But after this experience my mom found out that the woman died a few years ago of cancer. The air had a sweet smell of daffodils. My mom turned to the person next to her and spoke in thoughts, not words, 'A bit further down the road my deceased parents are waiting for me.' At that moment, someone said, 'Not yet.' My mother woke up on the floor in the living room with my uncle and I helping to bring her to the sofa. This isn't the end of this experience though. My mother said that while she was lying on the sofa she was aware of the fact she was on the sofa and I was sitting next to her in the chair asking the whole time if she's alright. She saw a man leaning against our coffee table. My mom said that she couldn't understand who the man was. She thought it was maybe a doctor and she didn't understand where he came from because she was still a bit dizzy from the fall. I was sitting next to her and I didn't see anyone. Apparently the man had shoulder-length, long wavy hair and was wearing a long white dress with a rope around his waist. Mom said that he came closer to her, near her face and looked at her with a very concerned and loving look in his big round brown eyes. Then he turned his head a bit to the side and said something along the lines of 'She's back, she returned.' After that he stood there near the table for short while and then raised from the floor in the corner of our living room and disappeared like in a fog. After lying on the sofa for an hour, my mother was fine and back to her old self. I think it's great she had an experience like this. We both think that the man in the living room must have been her guardian angel or someone who is looking after her during this life. Maybe it was the same person who was 'driving' her in the vehicle before. My mother has told this story to many people and most of them were very interested to hear about it. Thanks for reading. Be kind to each other and appreciate the people who love you. Life is very short.

arrival.other_being_detail: A person was seated to her left and was 'driving' her in a roofless vehicle; later, she saw a man in the living room with shoulder-length wavy hair wearing a long white dress with a rope around his waist, with a loving/concerned look, who said 'She's back, she returned.'

environment.environment_other_detail: Road with high trees on both sides; pavement with people walking; green grass and trees; beautiful detached houses in the distance; roofless vehicle gliding/floating; air smelled sweet like daffodils.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Fell from an unstable stool and hit her head on a hard floor.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Also saw an apparently non-physical man in the living room after returning to the sofa.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Instead of a tunnel, she found herself in a roofless vehicle moving along a road, seeing deceased people; she then heard 'Not yet' and returned, followed by a brief post-return vision of a man in the living room.
stage_sequence.simultaneous_stage_detail: While on the sofa, she was aware of being on the sofa and hearing her daughter, while also seeing the man leaning against the coffee table.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Transitional/otherworld scene as a roofless vehicle gliding on a tree-lined road with a pavement of happy people; strong olfactory detail (sweet smell of daffodils); post-return apparition-like figure in the living room who rose and disappeared 'like in a fog.'
unique_elements.notable_quotes: "A bit further down the road my deceased parents are waiting for me." / "Not yet." / "She's back, she returned."
